ambiguities: WEB-4 carry-to counts other visible cards "whose middle is above the pointer". It does not say whether the middle is measured before or after the carried card shifts the cards, or how a pointer exactly at a middle counts (PRB-023).
Whether clicking "Try again" gives it focus is a platform default. FOC-1 then moves focus to the place title only if the button had focus (PRB-004).
Whether the filter text matches a word as a substring of the title is implied by the example "sl-11" -> SL-110 to SL-119, not stated.
